Natural relatively small wide-set erect equilateral-triangular ears with slightly rounded tips, fur-lined interiors, opening gently forward/outward, not folded drop or oversized fox ears. profileEvidence.summary: Chukotka Sled Dogs learn quickly and retain the skills needed for long journeys, with endurance central to their working character. Their response to people can range from friendly to quietly defensive. These Indigenous transport dogs of northeastern Asia carried people and cargo across sea ice and tundra; some also pull wheeled carts in summer.
profileEvidence.shortDescription: Quick-learning Arctic transport dogs, valued for long-distance endurance and a response to people that varies.
